title.narrative: Irish Aid to UNHCR Sudan Regional Refugee Response

description.narrative: Voluntary contribution to UNHCR's activities in line with the 2025 Sudan Regional Refugee Response Plan (RRP) for their activities in the Central African Republic, Chad, Egypt, Ethiopia, Libya, South Sudan and Uganda in line. In line with the Response Plan, UNHCR will prioritise the delivery of protection services, and life-saving assistance, including shelter, education, water, sanitation and hygeone, and site management for refugees and IDPs. UNHCR is also engaging with development actors to facilitate support to host communities with the inclusion of refugees in expanded national services, to foster resilience and self-reliance, and for the sustainable reintegration of returnees. 5 million refugees, returnees, third country nationals and host communities are targeted as in need of assistance in line with their response plan.
